title: STM32F446RET6 Control and Timing Sheet

captionZh: STM32F446RET6 分页汇集六路 PWM、ADC 输入、Hall 与编码器信号、SPI、USB、SWD、EN_GATE、DC_CAL、FAULT 和 OCTW。

title: Motor, Hall, Power, and Service Connectors
titleZh: 电机、Hall、电源与调试接口分页
caption: The connector sheet routes U/V/W, Hall A_H1/B_H2/C_H3, 12 V input, OLED, serial, fan PWM, ST-Link, and USB-C interfaces.
captionZh: 连接器分页引出 U/V/W、Hall A_H1/B_H2/C_H3、12 V 输入、OLED、串口、风扇 PWM、ST-Link 与 USB-C 接口。

title: Current, Voltage, and Temperature Sampling
titleZh: 电流、电压与温度采样分页
caption: This sheet shows two phase-current inputs, bus current and voltage, three phase-voltage dividers, PCB temperature, and a labeled 1.65 V bias path.
captionZh: 该分页展示两相电流、母线电流与电压、三相电压分压、PCB 温度，以及标注为 1.65 V 的偏置通路。

title: HY3010D Three-Phase Half-Bridge
titleZh: HY3010D 三相半桥功率级
caption: Six HY3010D MOSFETs form the U/V/W half-bridges, with 20 mΩ phase shunts and a 4 mΩ bus shunt visible in the same power-stage sheet.
captionZh: 六颗 HY3010D 组成 U/V/W 三组半桥，同页还能看到 20 mΩ 相电流采样电阻与 4 mΩ 母线采样电阻。

caption: The DRV8301DCAR sheet connects six PWM inputs to three gate pairs and exposes SPI, EN_GATE, nFAULT, OCTW, current-shunt outputs, and a 5 V buck stage.
captionZh: DRV8301DCAR 分页把六路 PWM 接到三组栅极，并引出 SPI、EN_GATE、nFAULT、OCTW、电流采样放大输出和 5 V 降压级。

captionZh: 渲染显示四路信号排针、SOP16 的 U2 封装、五位输出连接器与四个 LED 位置；配套原理图才把 U2 标为 ULN2003A。

captionZh: 原理图让四路输入穿过 ULN2003A 通道到达输出连接器，并在每个驱动节点上接一支 LED 电阻支路。

captionZh: Notion 笔记中的另一张生成图比较了 Qt 包发现时的 CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH、Qt6_DIR 与系统默认路径。

captionZh: 生成式时序图展示 windeployqt 扫描可执行程序的 Qt 依赖，并把核心 DLL、平台插件与资源复制到部署目录。

title: Two decoder branches in the report
titleZh: 报告中的双路译码接线

captionZh: 作业报告示意图从 Arduino Uno 分出两路译码/显示支路，旁边接入两个开关。它记录的是预期拓扑；现场实物使用 Arduino Nano。

title: Nano counter running on the bench
titleZh: Nano 计数器现场运行
caption: Across the 17-second bench clip, the Arduino Nano stays powered while both illuminated digits change. No button press appears, so the video does not demonstrate pause or reset.
captionZh: 17 秒现场视频里，Arduino Nano 保持上电，两位发光数字持续变化。画面没有按键操作，因此不能用它说明暂停或复位。

title: Rollover, pause, and reset requirements
titleZh: 归零、暂停与复位要求
caption: This course slide sets the assessed behavior: two digits, rollover at the assigned group number, and buttons for pause and reset. Its repeating rollover rule must be read separately from the later A17 report sequence.
captionZh: 这页课件规定了考核功能：两位显示、到小组号归零，以及暂停和复位按键。这里的循环归零要求需要与 A17 报告后来的计数描述分开阅读。

title: Arduino-decoder-display block diagram
titleZh: Arduino—译码器—显示框图
caption: The course block diagram reduces the circuit to Arduino, BCD decoder, and display, while warning that resistors and switches are omitted. It is a useful interface map before the breadboard doubles the display branch.
captionZh: 课程框图把电路压成 Arduino、BCD 译码器和显示三段，同时提醒电阻与开关未画出。它适合先理清接口，再看面包板如何把显示支路复制成两份。

title: 7447 pins, power, and segment resistors
titleZh: 7447 引脚、供电与段限流
caption: A-D inputs and a-g outputs sit beside the 7447 pinout, with reminders for 330-ohm resistors, IC orientation, Vcc, and GND. These are the electrical checks between a BCD row and a visible digit.
captionZh: 7447 引脚图旁标出了 A-D 输入与 a-g 输出，并提醒 330 欧姆限流、芯片方向、Vcc 和 GND。这些电气检查把一行 BCD 与可见数字接在一起。

title: Six-pin switch input example
titleZh: 六脚按键输入示例
caption: A six-pin self-locking switch, the D7/D6 Serial sketch, and pull-up/pull-down examples share this course page. Together they explain why digitalRead needs a defined idle level before the code assigns button meaning.
captionZh: 这页课件把六脚自锁按键、D7/D6 串口示例和上拉/下拉电路放在一起，说明 digitalRead 必须先有确定的空闲电平，代码才能解释按键状态。

title: M1-M4 functional-block sequence
titleZh: M1-M4 功能块验证顺序

captionZh: M1 到 M4 把计时、译码、显示、编程与测试拆开，并要求各功能块独立检查。按这个顺序，两份 demo sketch 属于前期检查点，不是最终集成程序。

title: Uno/CD4511 one-digit simulation reference

title: Report diagram with two decoder branches

title: Units and tens split in the report
titleZh: 报告中的个位与十位拆分
caption: The report computes units with Num % 10 and tens with (Num / 10) % 10, then writes each result through four BCD outputs. This is the code-level split from one counter state to two display branches.
captionZh: 报告用 Num % 10 计算个位，用 (Num / 10) % 10 计算十位，再把两个结果分别写入四路 BCD 输出。这段代码把一个计数状态拆给两条显示支路。

title: HIGH and LOW switch branches in the report

captionZh: 报告截图里，switch 1 在 HIGH 时进入按下分支，switch 2 则在 LOW 时进入按下分支。由于缺少完整最终接线和源码，这里的混合极性保持原样。
